snippet.title: PLATONICA SPACE｜Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Releasing on Steam August 14: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3846480/_/
Open the door and step into someone's memories.
Platonica Space is a sci-fi exploration adventure where you search countless rooms to recover lost memories.
